subject: planner: the recursive cte will make UPDATE's result wrong (#49400)
summary: Planner change adds missing `handleHelper` stack cleanup when rebuilding the seed part of a recursive CTE, preventing leaked handle maps from corrupting outer statements (e.g., UPDATE with subquery/view using a recursive CTE). The added integration test reproduces issue #48969 and validates the intended semantics (only ids 1..3 updated). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the planner change after checking the minimal surrounding call paths and noting upstream/master later hardens the same handleHelper restoration logic further.
